verdict.rationale: CoreWeave documents AI Object Storage as S3-compatible network storage explicitly for storing training data, checkpoints, and model weights independent of GPU compute lifecycle, with features like lifecycle policies, cache warming, and group-based access that reinforce durability and reuse across runs (coreweave-docs-10, 37-44). This directly satisfies the need for persistent storage that outlives any single GPU rental. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of block/file storage or Kubernetes PersistentVolume attach semantics (vs. S3 API access) and independent hands-on confirmation of data surviving teardown.
